name: Japanese Communist Party (日本共産党)
role: Political party in the National Diet
notes: Key proponent of a modern progressive annual net wealth tax (富裕税) in the National Diet since the 2010s.

name: Akira Koike (小池晃)
role: Member of the House of Councillors (Proportional), Secretariat Head of JCP
notes: Secretariat Head of the Japanese Communist Party and physician; repeatedly introduced the party's wealth tax bill in Diet debates.

name: Daimon Mikishi (大門実紀史)
role: Member of the House of Councillors (Proportional)
notes: Longstanding JCP financial/fiscal committee spokesperson in the House of Councillors advocating for wealth tax on net financial assets above 500 million yen.

name: Akira Kasai (笠井亮)
role: Member of the House of Representatives (Tokyo proportional)
notes: JCP House of Representatives member and policy committee chair advocating wealth tax on high stocks and real estate.

name: Toru Miyamoto (宮本徹)
role: Member of the House of Representatives (Tokyo proportional)
notes: Raised wealth tax proposals in House of Representatives Financial Committee meetings citing European models.

name: Banri Kaieda (海江田万里)
role: Member of the House of Representatives (Tokyo 1st district), former Vice-Speaker of Shugiin
notes: Prominent CDP leader and economist; proposed examining a time-limited wealth tax in Diet debate following the pandemic.

name: Yasue Funayama (舟山康江)
role: Member of the House of Councillors (Yamagata at-large district), DPFP Executive Board Member
notes: DPFP House of Councillors representative for Yamagata; highlighted international calls for wealth tax to tackle inequality in plenary Diet speech.

name: Citizens' Liaison Committee for Fair Taxation (公正な税制を求める市民連絡会)
role: Civil society advocacy coalition for progressive tax reform
notes: Leading Japanese civil society coalition campaigning for fair taxation, progressive asset taxation, and wealth tax.

name: Kenji Utsunomiya (宇都宮健児)
role: Co-representative of Citizens' Liaison Committee for Fair Taxation, former President of Nichibenren
affiliation: Citizens' Liaison Committee for Fair Taxation
notes: Former president of Nichibenren and candidate for Governor of Tokyo; co-editor of 2025 book 'Why Not Tax Wealth? Introduction to Wealth Tax'.

name: Satoshi Daigo (醍醐聰)
role: Professor Emeritus, The University of Tokyo
notes: Professor Emeritus of Accounting at the University of Tokyo; developed a comprehensive wealth tax institutional design and revenue simulation model in Japan.

name: Yoshikazu Miki (三木義一)
role: Former President and Professor Emeritus of Aoyama Gakuin University, Lawyer
notes: Prominent Japanese tax law scholar and former president of Aoyama Gakuin University; co-author advocating a 2% minimum asset tax.

name: Kan Goda (合田寛)
role: Senior Researcher, Political Economy Research Institute
notes: Senior researcher at the Political Economy Research Institute; author of book chapter and series on international movements for billionaire and wealth taxation.

name: Katsuhiko Kondo (近藤克彦)
notes: Certified public tax accountant; author of chapter examining the practical and administrative feasibility of implementing a wealth tax in Japan.

name: Motonan Narita (成田元男)
role: US Enrolled Agent and tax scholar
notes: Tax scholar and author co-proposing a minimum 2% wealth tax proposal alongside Yoshikazu Miki.
